body.name: Censoring-aware finite-sample outer set
body.construction:
Fix \(0=a_0<\cdots<a_m=\tau\), let \(I_i=[a_i,a_{i+1})\) for \(0\leq i<m-1\), let \(I_{m-1}=[a_{m-1},\tau]\), and let the residual death cell be \(D(z)>\tau\); fix also readmission bins \(B_j\).  In cell \((z,x)\), give every observable moment \(A^{zx}_{ij}\), \(Y^{zx}_i\), and \(V^{zx}_j\) an interval centered at its empirical proportion, clipped to \([0,1]\), with radius \(\sqrt{\log(2J/\alpha)/(2N_{zx})}\) when \(N_{zx}>0\), and use \([0,1]\) when \(N_{zx}=0\).  Give \(p_x\) the interval centered at \(\widehat p_x\), clipped to \([0,1]\), with radius \(\sqrt{\log(2J/\alpha)/(2n)}\).  Define \(\mathscr E_n\) as the event on which all these primitive intervals cover simultaneously.  Define \(\mathcal B_n\) as all tuples of probability tables \(\pi^{zx}_{ij},\pi^{zx}_{\infty j}\), covariate masses \(p_x\), censoring vectors \(g^{zx}_i\), and candidate observable moments \(A^{zx}_{ij},Y^{zx}_i,V^{zx}_j\) such that every candidate lies in its corresponding interval; for every \((z,x)\), \(\sum_{i=0}^{m-1}\sum_j\pi^{zx}_{ij}+\sum_j\pi^{zx}_{\infty j}=1\), all table entries are nonnegative, and the table obeys the event-order restrictions; and, for \(0\leq i<m\),
\[
g^{zx}_{i+1}\pi^{zx}_{ij}\leq A^{zx}_{ij}\leq g^{zx}_i\pi^{zx}_{ij},
\qquad
Y^{zx}_i=g^{zx}_i\left\{\sum_{h\geq i,j}\pi^{zx}_{hj}+\sum_j\pi^{zx}_{\infty j}\right\},
\]
while \(V^{zx}_j=g^{zx}_m\pi^{zx}_{\infty j}\) and \(1\geq g^{zx}_0\geq\cdots\geq g^{zx}_m\geq\gamma\).  In the last finite bin the lower bracket is \(g^{zx}_m\pi^{zx}_{m-1,j}\), so death mass at \(\tau\) is retained and is weighted at \(G_{zx}(\tau)=g^{zx}_m\).  Define \(\mathcal C_n\) as the union of the exact chain-flow surface images over \(\mathcal B_n\).
